import unittest
import torch
from connectomics.model.block import *
from connectomics.model.backbone.repvgg import RepVGGBlock2D, RepVGGBlock3D
from connectomics.model.backbone.botnet import BottleBlock

class TestNeuralNetworkComponents(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_convolutional_layers(self):
        """Validate standard 2D and 3D convolution blocks."""
        batch_size, depth, height, width = 2, 8, 32, 32
        input_channels, output_channels = 16, 32
        
        # Evaluate 2D block
        conv_layer_2d = conv2d_norm_act(input_channels, output_channels)
        input_data = torch.rand(batch_size, input_channels, height, width)
        result = conv_layer_2d(input_data)
        self.assertEqual(result.shape, (batch_size, output_channels, height, width))
        
        # Evaluate 3D block
        conv_layer_3d = conv3d_norm_act(input_channels, output_channels)
        input_data_3d = torch.rand(batch_size, input_channels, depth, height, width)
        result_3d = conv_layer_3d(input_data_3d)
        self.assertEqual(result_3d.shape, (batch_size, output_channels, depth, height, width))

    def _validate_module(self, data, module_class, expected_shape, **config):
        model_instance = module_class(**config)
        output = model_instance(data)
        self.assertEqual(output.shape, expected_shape)

    def test_residual_architectures(self):
        """
        Assess residual modules including SE variants for both 2D and 3D cases.
        """
        batch_size, depth, height, width = 2, 9, 33, 33
        input_features = 16
        
        for target_channels in [input_features, input_features * 2]:
            # 2D testing setup
            input_tensor_2d = torch.rand(batch_size, input_features, height, width)
            shape_2d = (batch_size, target_channels, height, width)
            
            for architecture in [BasicBlock2d, BasicBlock2dSE]:
                self._validate_module(
                    input_tensor_2d, architecture, shape_2d,
                    in_planes=input_features, planes=target_channels, dilation=4)
            
            # 3D testing setup
            input_tensor_3d = torch.rand(batch_size, input_features, depth, height, width)
            shape_3d = (batch_size, target_channels, depth, height, width)
            
            for variant in [BasicBlock3d, BasicBlock3dSE, BasicBlock3dPA, BasicBlock3dPASE]:
                self._validate_module(
                    input_tensor_3d, variant, shape_3d,
                    in_planes=input_features, planes=target_channels, dilation=4, isotropic=False)

    def _check_nonlocal_output(self, nl_module, input_batch):
        result = nl_module(input_batch)
        self.assertEqual(result.shape, input_batch.shape)

    def test_non_local_components(self):
        """Verify non-local processing units across dimensions."""
        batch_size, channels, depth, height, width = 2, 32, 17, 33, 33
        
        # 1D non-local
        self._check_nonlocal_output(
            NonLocalBlock1D(channels), torch.rand(batch_size, channels, width))
        
        # 2D non-local
        self._check_nonlocal_output(
            NonLocalBlock2D(channels), torch.rand(batch_size, channels, height, width))
        
        # 3D non-local
        self._check_nonlocal_output(
            NonLocalBlock3D(channels), torch.rand(batch_size, channels, depth, height, width))

    def test_repvgg_structure_2d(self):
        """Validate 2D RepVGG architectural components."""
        batch_size, height, width = 2, 32, 32
        input_dims = 8
        
        for output_dims in [8, 16]:
            for dilate_factor in [1, 4]:
                # Training mode block
                training_block = RepVGGBlock2D(
                    input_dims, output_dims, dilation=dilate_factor, deploy=False)
                training_block.eval()
                
                # Convert to deployment form
                reparam_kernel, reparam_bias = training_block.repvgg_convert()
                
                # Deployed mode block
                deployed_block = RepVGGBlock2D(
                    input_dims, output_dims, dilation=dilate_factor, deploy=True)
                deployed_block.load_reparam_kernel(reparam_kernel, reparam_bias)
                deployed_block.eval()
                
                # Input validation
                sample_input = torch.rand(batch_size, input_dims, height, width)
                train_output = training_block(sample_input)
                deploy_output = deployed_block(sample_input)
                
                self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(train_output, deploy_output, atol=1e-6))

    def test_repvgg_structure_3d(self):
        """Validate 3D RepVGG architectural components."""
        batch_size, depth, height, width = 2, 8, 32, 32
        input_dims = 8
        
        for output_dims in [8, 16]:
            for iso_flag in [True, False]:
                for dilate_step in [1, 4]:
                    # Training configuration
                    train_model = RepVGGBlock3D(
                        input_dims, output_dims, dilation=dilate_step,
                        isotropic=iso_flag, deploy=False)
                    train_model.eval()
                    
                    # Conversion step
                    converted_kernel, converted_bias = train_model.repvgg_convert()
                    
                    # Deployment configuration
                    deploy_model = RepVGGBlock3D(
                        input_dims, output_dims, dilation=dilate_step,
                        isotropic=iso_flag, deploy=True)
                    deploy_model.load_reparam_kernel(converted_kernel, converted_bias)
                    deploy_model.eval()
                    
                    # Verification
                    test_input = torch.rand(batch_size, input_dims, depth, height, width)
                    train_result = train_model(test_input)
                    deploy_result = deploy_model(test_input)
                    
                    self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(train_result, deploy_result, atol=1e-6))

    def test_bottleneck_attention_mechanisms(self):
        # Absolute Position Embedding variant
        module_abs = BottleBlock(
            dim=16, fmap_size=(8, 8, 8), dim_out=16, proj_factor=4,
            downsample=False, dim_head=16)
        sample_data = torch.randn(2, 16, 8, 8, 8)
        self.assertEqual(module_abs(sample_data).shape, (2, 16, 8, 8, 8))
        
        # Relative Position Embedding variant
        module_rel = BottleBlock(
            dim=16, fmap_size=(8, 16, 18), dim_out=16, proj_factor=4,
            downsample=False, dim_head=16, rel_pos_emb=True)
        sample_data_rel = torch.randn(2, 16, 8, 16, 18)
        self.assertEqual(module_rel(sample_data_rel).shape, (2, 16, 8, 16, 18))

    def test_blur_pooling_functionality(self):
        # Isotropic 3D blur pooling
        blur_pool_iso = BlurPool3D(channels=10, stride=4)
        input_iso = torch.Tensor(1, 10, 128, 128, 128)
        output_iso = blur_pool_iso(input_iso)
        self.assertEqual(output_iso.shape, (1, 10, 32, 32, 32))
        
        # Anisotropic 3D blur pooling
        blur_pool_aniso = BlurPool3D(channels=10, stride=(1, 2, 2))
        input_aniso = torch.Tensor(1, 10, 32, 64, 64)
        output_aniso = blur_pool_aniso(input_aniso)
        self.assertEqual(output_aniso.shape, (1, 10, 32, 32, 32))
        
        # 2D blur pooling
        blur_pool_2d = BlurPool2D(channels=10, stride=2)
        input_2d = torch.Tensor(1, 10, 64, 64)
        output_2d = blur_pool_2d(input_2d)
        self.assertEqual(output_2d.shape, (1, 10, 32, 32))
        
        # 1D blur pooling
        feature_count, pool_stride, seq_len = 4, 2, 16
        blur_pool_1d = BlurPool1D(channels=feature_count, stride=pool_stride)
        input_1d = torch.Tensor(1, feature_count, seq_len)
        output_1d = blur_pool_1d(input_1d)
        self.assertEqual(output_1d.shape, (1, feature_count, seq_len // pool_stride))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import argparse
from datetime import datetime
from src.pathfinder import PathFinder
from src.core.backends.poetrade import PoeTrade
from src.commons import LEAGUE_NAMES, init_logger
from src.config.user_config import UserConfig
from src.trading.items import ItemList
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class DataGathererSettings:
    league_name: str
    output_dir: str
    collect_all_bulk: bool
    apply_filtering: bool

def create_timestamped_filename() -> str:
    now = str(datetime.now()).split(".")[0]
    for char in ["-", ":", " "]:
        now = now.replace(char, "_")
    return f"{now}.json"

def parse_command_line_arguments() -> DataGathererSettings:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Utility to gather trade data for PathFinder processing"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--league",
        default=LEAGUE_NAMES[0],
        help=f"Target league identifier (e.g., 'Synthesis', 'Hardcore Synthesis', 'Flashback Event (BRE001)'). Defaults to '{LEAGUE_NAMES[0]}'"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--path",
        default="data_analysis/raw",
        help="Directory path where collected data will be stored"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--fullbulk",
        action="store_true",
        default=False,
        help="Include all supported bulk items in collection"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--skipfilter",
        action="store_true",
        default=False,
        help="Skip item-pair filtering and use raw data"
    )
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    return DataGathererSettings(
        league_name=args.league,
        output_dir=args.path,
        collect_all_bulk=args.fullbulk,
        apply_filtering=not args.skipfilter
    )

class DataCollector:
    def execute(self):
        settings = parse_command_line_arguments()
        output_file_path = f"{settings.output_dir}/{create_timestamped_filename()}"
        
        loaded_items = ItemList.load_from_file()
        user_preferences = UserConfig.from_file()
        
        # Initialize backend with item list
        trade_backend = PoeTrade(loaded_items)
        
        # Determine item pairs based on configuration
        if settings.apply_filtering:
            selected_pairs = user_preferences.get_item_pairs()
        else:
            selected_pairs = loaded_items.get_item_list_for_backend(
                trade_backend, {"fullbulk": settings.collect_all_bulk}
            )
        
        # Run pathfinding process
        finder = PathFinder(settings.league_name, selected_pairs, user_preferences)
        finder.run(iterations=2)
        
        # Save results to file
        with open(output_file_path, "w") as file_handle:
            serialized_data = finder.prepickle()
            file_handle.write(serialized_data)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    init_logger(True)
    DataCollector().execute()

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import os
from .utils import (
    create_grid3D,
    plot_mask3D,
    SmoothConv3D,
)

class Seg3dLossless(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, 
                 query_func, b_min, b_max, resolutions,
                 channels=1, balance_value=0.5, align_corners=False, 
                 visualize=False, debug=False, use_cuda_impl=False, faster=False, 
                 use_shadow=False, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.query_func = query_func
        
        # Store bounding boxes and resolutions as buffers
        self.register_buffer('b_min', torch.tensor(b_min).float().unsqueeze(1))
        self.register_buffer('b_max', torch.tensor(b_max).float().unsqueeze(1))
        
        # Process resolutions
        if isinstance(resolutions[0], int):
            resolutions = torch.tensor([(res, res, res) for res in resolutions])
        else:
            resolutions = torch.tensor(resolutions)
        self.register_buffer('resolutions', resolutions)
        
        # Basic configuration
        self.batchsize = self.b_min.size(0)
        assert self.batchsize == 1
        self.balance_value = balance_value
        self.channels = channels
        assert self.channels == 1
        self.align_corners = align_corners
        self.visualize = visualize
        self.debug = debug
        self.use_cuda_impl = use_cuda_impl
        self.faster = faster
        self.use_shadow = use_shadow
        
        # Validate resolutions
        for resolution in resolutions:
            assert resolution[0] % 2 == 1 and resolution[1] % 2 == 1, \
                f"resolution {resolution} needs to be odd due to align_corner."
        
        # Initialize first resolution grid
        init_coords = create_grid3D(
            0, resolutions[-1]-1, steps=resolutions[0], device="cpu")
        init_coords = init_coords.unsqueeze(0).repeat(self.batchsize, 1, 1)
        self.register_buffer('init_coords', init_coords)
        
        # Tracking structures
        calculated = torch.zeros(
            (self.resolutions[-1][2], self.resolutions[-1][1], self.resolutions[-1][0]), 
            dtype=torch.bool)
        self.register_buffer('calculated', calculated)
        
        # Define neighborhood offsets
        gird8_offsets = torch.stack(torch.meshgrid([
            torch.tensor([-1, 0, 1]), torch.tensor([-1, 0, 1]), torch.tensor([-1, 0, 1])
        ])).int().view(3, -1).t()
        self.register_buffer('gird8_offsets', gird8_offsets)
        
        # Smooth convolution layers for different kernel sizes
        self.smooth_conv3x3 = SmoothConv3D(in_channels=1, out_channels=1, kernel_size=3)
        self.smooth_conv5x5 = SmoothConv3D(in_channels=1, out_channels=1, kernel_size=5)
        self.smooth_conv7x7 = SmoothConv3D(in_channels=1, out_channels=1, kernel_size=7)
        self.smooth_conv9x9 = SmoothConv3D(in_channels=1, out_channels=1, kernel_size=9)
        
        # CUDA implementation setup
        if self.use_cuda_impl:
            from .interp2x_boundary3d import Interp2xBoundary3d
            self.upsampler = Interp2xBoundary3d()

    def batch_eval(self, coords, **kwargs):
        """Evaluate occupancy values at given coordinates."""
        coords = coords.detach()
        
        # Normalize coordinates to [b_min, b_max]
        if self.align_corners:
            coords_norm = coords.float() / (self.resolutions[-1] - 1)
        else:
            step = 1.0 / self.resolutions[-1].float()
            coords_norm = coords.float() / self.resolutions[-1] + step / 2
            
        coords_final = coords_norm * (self.b_max - self.b_min) + self.b_min
        
        # Query function
        occupancys = self.query_func(**kwargs, points=coords_final)
        if isinstance(occupancys, list):
            occupancys = torch.stack(occupancys)
            
        assert len(occupancys.size()) == 3, \
            "query_func should return a occupancy with shape of [bz, C, N]"
        return occupancys

    def forward(self, **kwargs):
        if self.faster:
            return self._forward_faster(**kwargs)
        else:
            return self._forward(**kwargs)

    def _forward_faster(self, **kwargs):
        """Optimized version that sacrifices some accuracy for speed."""
        final_W = self.resolutions[-1][0]
        final_H = self.resolutions[-1][1]
        final_D = self.resolutions[-1][2]
        
        for resolution in self.resolutions:
            W, H, D = resolution
            stride = (self.resolutions[-1] - 1) / (resolution - 1)
            
            # Initial evaluation
            if torch.equal(resolution, self.resolutions[0]):
                coords = self.init_coords.clone()
                occupancys = self.batch_eval(coords, **kwargs)
                occupancys = occupancys.view(self.batchsize, self.channels, D, H, W)
                
                # Early exit if no positive samples
                if (occupancys > 0.5).sum() == 0:
                    return None
                
                if self.visualize:
                    self.plot(occupancys, coords, final_D, final_H, final_W)
                
                with torch.no_grad():
                    coords_accum = coords / stride
                    
            # Final upsampling step
            elif torch.equal(resolution, self.resolutions[-1]):
                if self.use_cuda_impl:
                    occupancys, is_boundary = self.upsampler(occupancys.contiguous())
                else:
                    with torch.no_grad():
                        valid = F.interpolate(
                            (occupancys > self.balance_value).float(), 
                            size=(D, H, W), mode="trilinear", align_corners=True)
                    occupancys = F.interpolate(
                        occupancys.float(), 
                        size=(D, H, W), mode="trilinear", align_corners=True)
                    is_boundary = valid == 0.5
            # Intermediate upsampling steps
            else:
                coords_accum *= 2
                if self.use_cuda_impl:
                    occupancys, is_boundary = self.upsampler(occupancys)
                else:
                    with torch.no_grad():
                        valid = F.interpolate(
                            (occupancys > self.balance_value).float(), 
                            size=(D, H, W), mode="trilinear", align_corners=True)
                    occupancys = F.interpolate(
                        occupancys.float(), 
                        size=(D, H, W), mode="trilinear", align_corners=True)
                    is_boundary = (valid > 0.0) & (valid < 1.0)
                
                with torch.no_grad():
                    # Apply appropriate smoothing based on resolution stage
                    if torch.equal(resolution, self.resolutions[1]):
                        is_boundary = (self.smooth_conv9x9(is_boundary.float()) > 0)[0, 0]
                    elif torch.equal(resolution, self.resolutions[2]):
                        is_boundary = (self.smooth_conv7x7(is_boundary.float()) > 0)[0, 0]
                    else:
                        is_boundary = (self.smooth_conv3x3(is_boundary.float()) > 0)[0, 0]
                    
                    # Exclude already evaluated points
                    is_boundary[coords_accum[0, :, 2],
                                coords_accum[0, :, 1], 
                                coords_accum[0, :, 0]] = False
                    
                    # Extract boundary coordinates
                    point_coords = is_boundary.permute(2, 1, 0).nonzero().unsqueeze(0)
                    point_indices = (
                        point_coords[:, :, 2] * H * W + 
                        point_coords[:, :, 1] * W + 
                        point_coords[:, :, 0])
                    
                    R, C, D, H, W = occupancys.shape
                    coords = point_coords * stride
                    
                if coords.size(1) == 0:
                    continue
                    
                occupancys_topk = self.batch_eval(coords, **kwargs)
                
                # Update occupancy grid with new predictions
                point_indices = point_indices.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, C, -1)
                occupancys = (
                    occupancys.reshape(R, C, D * H * W)
                    .scatter_(2, point_indices, occupancys_topk)
                    .view(R, C, D, H, W)
                )
                
                with torch.no_grad():
                    voxels = coords / stride
                    coords_accum = torch.cat([
                        voxels, 
                        coords_accum
                    ], dim=1).unique(dim=1)
        
        return occupancys

    def _forward(self, **kwargs):
        """Standard implementation with conflict checking."""
        final_W = self.resolutions[-1][0]
        final_H = self.resolutions[-1][1]
        final_D = self.resolutions[-1][2]
        calculated = self.calculated.clone()
        
        for resolution in self.resolutions:
            W, H, D = resolution
            stride = (self.resolutions[-1] - 1) / (resolution - 1)
            
            if self.visualize:
                this_stage_coords = []
            
            # First resolution processing
            if torch.equal(resolution, self.resolutions[0]):
                coords = self.init_coords.clone()
                occupancys = self.batch_eval(coords, **kwargs)
                occupancys = occupancys.view(self.batchsize, self.channels, D, H, W)
                
                if self.visualize:
                    self.plot(occupancys, coords, final_D, final_H, final_W)
                
                with torch.no_grad():
                    coords_accum = coords / stride
                    calculated[coords[0, :, 2], coords[0, :, 1], coords[0, :, 0]] = True
            
            # Subsequent resolution processing
            else:
                coords_accum *= 2
                if self.use_cuda_impl:
                    occupancys, is_boundary = self.upsampler(occupancys)
                else:
                    with torch.no_grad():
                        valid = F.interpolate(
                            (occupancys > self.balance_value).float(), 
                            size=(D, H, W), mode="trilinear", align_corners=True)
                    occupancys = F.interpolate(
                        occupancys.float(), 
                        size=(D, H, W), mode="trilinear", align_corners=True)
                    is_boundary = (valid > 0.0) & (valid < 1.0)
                
                with torch.no_grad():
                    # Shadow handling for final resolution
                    if self.use_shadow and torch.equal(resolution, self.resolutions[-1]):
                        depth_res = resolution[2].item()
                        depth_index = torch.linspace(0, depth_res-1, steps=depth_res).to(occupancys.device)
                        depth_index_max = torch.max( 
                            (occupancys > self.balance_value) * (depth_index + 1), dim=-1, keepdim=True)[0] - 1
                        shadow = depth_index < depth_index_max
                        is_boundary[shadow] = False
                        is_boundary = is_boundary[0, 0]
                    else:
                        is_boundary = (self.smooth_conv3x3(is_boundary.float()) > 0)[0, 0]
                    
                    # Exclude already processed points
                    is_boundary[coords_accum[0, :, 2],
                                coords_accum[0, :, 1], 
                                coords_accum[0, :, 0]] = False
                    
                    # Get boundary coordinates
                    point_coords = is_boundary.permute(2, 1, 0).nonzero().unsqueeze(0)
                    point_indices = (
                        point_coords[:, :, 2] * H * W + 
                        point_coords[:, :, 1] * W + 
                        point_coords[:, :, 0])
                    
                    R, C, D, H, W = occupancys.shape
                    occupancys_interp = torch.gather(
                        occupancys.reshape(R, C, D * H * W), 2, point_indices.unsqueeze(1))
                    coords = point_coords * stride
                    
                if coords.size(1) == 0:
                    continue
                    
                occupancys_topk = self.batch_eval(coords, **kwargs)
                if self.visualize:
                    this_stage_coords.append(coords)
                
                # Update grid with new predictions
                point_indices = point_indices.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, C, -1)
                occupancys = (
                    occupancys.reshape(R, C, D * H * W)
                    .scatter_(2, point_indices, occupancys_topk)
                    .view(R, C, D, H, W)
                )
                
                with torch.no_grad():
                    # Check for conflicts between interpolated and new values
                    conflicts = (
                        (occupancys_interp - self.balance_value) *
                        (occupancys_topk - self.balance_value) < 0
                    )[0, 0]
                    
                    if self.visualize:
                        self.plot(occupancys, coords, final_D, final_H, final_W)
                    
                    voxels = coords / stride
                    coords_accum = torch.cat([
                        voxels, 
                        coords_accum
                    ], dim=1).unique(dim=1)
                    calculated[coords[0, :, 2], coords[0, :, 1], coords[0, :, 0]] = True
                
                # Resolve conflicts iteratively
                while conflicts.sum() > 0:
                    if self.use_shadow and torch.equal(resolution, self.resolutions[-1]):
                        break
                    
                    with torch.no_grad():
                        conflicts_coords = coords[0, conflicts, :]
                        if self.debug:
                            self.plot(occupancys, conflicts_coords.unsqueeze(0), 
                                      final_D, final_H, final_W, title='conflicts')
                          
                        # Expand to 8-neighborhood
                        conflicts_boundary = (
                            conflicts_coords.int() +
                            self.gird8_offsets.unsqueeze(1) * stride.int()
                        ).reshape(-1, 3).long().unique(dim=0)
                        
                        # Clamp coordinates to valid range
                        conflicts_boundary[:, 0] = (
                            conflicts_boundary[:, 0].clamp(0, calculated.size(2) - 1))
                        conflicts_boundary[:, 1] = (
                            conflicts_boundary[:, 1].clamp(0, calculated.size(1) - 1))
                        conflicts_boundary[:, 2] = (
                            conflicts_boundary[:, 2].clamp(0, calculated.size(0) - 1))
                        
                        # Filter unprocessed points
                        coords = conflicts_boundary[
                            calculated[conflicts_boundary[:, 2], 
                                    conflicts_boundary[:, 1], 
                                    conflicts_boundary[:, 0]] == False
                        ]
                        
                        if self.debug:
                            self.plot(occupancys, coords.unsqueeze(0), 
                                      final_D, final_H, final_W, title='coords')
                            
                        coords = coords.unsqueeze(0)
                        point_coords = coords / stride
                        point_indices = (
                            point_coords[:, :, 2] * H * W + 
                            point_coords[:, :, 1] * W + 
                            point_coords[:, :, 0])
                        
                        R, C, D, H, W = occupancys.shape
                        occupancys_interp = torch.gather(
                            occupancys.reshape(R, C, D * H * W), 2, point_indices.unsqueeze(1))
                        coords = point_coords * stride
                        
                    if coords.size(1) == 0:
                        break
                        
                    occupancys_topk = self.batch_eval(coords, **kwargs)
                    if self.visualize:
                        this_stage_coords.append(coords)
                    
                    with torch.no_grad():
                        conflicts = (
                            (occupancys_interp - self.balance_value) *
                            (occupancys_topk - self.balance_value) < 0
                        )[0, 0]
                    
                    # Update grid again
                    point_indices = point_indices.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, C, -1)
                    occupancys = (
                        occupancys.reshape(R, C, D * H * W)
                        .scatter_(2, point_indices, occupancys_topk)
                        .view(R, C, D, H, W)
                    )
                    
                    with torch.no_grad():
                        voxels = coords / stride
                        coords_accum = torch.cat([
                            voxels, 
                            coords_accum
                        ], dim=1).unique(dim=1)
                        calculated[coords[0, :, 2], coords[0, :, 1], coords[0, :, 0]] = True
                
                if self.visualize:
                    this_stage_coords = torch.cat(this_stage_coords, dim=1)
                    self.plot(occupancys, this_stage_coords, final_D, final_H, final_W)
                    
        return occupancys

    def plot(self, occupancys, coords, final_D, final_H, final_W, title='', **kwargs):
        """Helper method for visualization."""
        final = F.interpolate(
            occupancys.float(), size=(final_D, final_H, final_W), 
            mode="trilinear", align_corners=True)
        x = coords[0, :, 0].to("cpu")
        y = coords[0, :, 1].to("cpu")
        z = coords[0, :, 2].to("cpu")
        
        plot_mask3D(
            final[0, 0].to("cpu"), title, (x, y, z), **kwargs)

from werkzeug.utils import secure_filename
from flask import session
from web import AUTH_USER_ID_KEY
from web.models.comment import Comment
from web.models.attached_file import AttachedFile
from web.models.user import User

def _extract_user_data(request):
    """Extract user data from request form.
    Args:
        request (flask.request): Flask request object.
    Returns:
        dict: User information extracted from form.
    """
    # TODO: validate
    return {
        'user_id': request.form['user_id'],
        'user_name': request.form['user_name'],
        'password': request.form['password'],
        'password_retype': request.form['password_retype']
    }

def add_comment_to_issue(request, issue, current_user):
    """Create and attach a new comment to an issue.
    Args:
        request (flask.request): Flask request object.
        issue (Issue): The issue to which the comment is added.
        current_user (User): Authenticated user creating the comment.
    """
    # TODO: validate
    if 'new_subject' in request.form:
        issue.subject = request.form['new_subject']
    
    if 'new_state' in request.form:
        issue.state_id = request.form['new_state']
    
    body_text = request.form.get('new_body', None)
    
    # Process uploaded files securely
    file_list = []
    for filename, file_obj in request.files.items():
        if filename and file_obj.filename:
            safe_name = secure_filename(file_obj.filename)
            file_content = file_obj.read()
            file_list.append(AttachedFile(None, safe_name, file_content))
    
    # Set attached_files to None if no valid files were uploaded
    if not file_list:
        file_list = None
    
    return Comment(issue, current_user, body_text, attached_files=file_list)

def authenticate_user(request):
    """Perform user authentication and store session state.
    Args:
        request (flask.request): Flask request object.
    Returns:
        bool: True if authentication succeeds.
    """
    # TODO: validate
    login_id = request.form['user_id']
    provided_password = request.form['password']
    
    found_user = User.get(login_id)
    if found_user is None:
        return False
    
    success = found_user.authenticate(provided_password)
    if success:
        session[AUTH_USER_ID_KEY] = login_id
    return success

def register_new_user(request):
    """Register a new user account.
    Args:
        request (flask.request): Flask request object.
    Returns:
        tuple: (User or None, error_message or None).
    """
    user_data = _extract_user_data(request)
    
    # Verify password confirmation matches
    if user_data['password'] != user_data['password_retype']:
        return (None, 'password mismatch')
    
    # Check if user ID already exists
    existing_user = User.get(user_data['user_id'])
    if existing_user is not None:
        return (None, f"id '{user_data['user_id']}' already registered")
    
    # Create new user instance
    new_user = User(
        user_data['user_id'], 
        user_data['user_name'], 
        user_data['password']
    )
    return (new_user, None)

def update_user_profile(request, logged_in_user):
    """Update profile information for an existing user.
    Args:
        request (flask.request): Flask request object.
        logged_in_user (User): Currently authenticated user.
    Returns:
        tuple: (User or None, error_message or None).
    """
    user_data = _extract_user_data(request)
    
    # Validate password confirmation
    if user_data['password'] != user_data['password_retype']:
        return (None, 'password mismatch')
    
    # Update username
    logged_in_user.name = user_data['user_name']
    
    # Conditionally update password if provided
    if user_data['password']:
        logged_in_user.change_password(user_data['password'])
    
    return (logged_in_user, None)

from datetime import datetime
from dateutil import tz
from flask_restful import Resource, reqparse
from coads import conversion, repository

# Initialize repositories and default conversion
token_repo = repository.TokenRepository()
client_factory = repository.ClientFactory()
conversion_s3_repo = repository.ConversionS3Repository()
default_conversion_config = None

class ConversionHandler(Resource):
    """Handles conversion data upload to Google Ads.
    
    Receives conversion events and uploads them to Google Ads via the
    ConversionUploadService. Also stores click IDs in S3 for logging.
    """
    app_config = None
    
    def get(self, customer_id):
        # Set up request parser with required parameters
        parser = reqparse.RequestParser()
        parser.add_argument('click_id', type=str, required=True)
        parser.add_argument('action_name', type=str, required=True)
        parser.add_argument('actioned_at', type=str, required=True)
        parser.add_argument('amount', type=float, required=True)
        parser.add_argument('currency', type=str, required=True)
        parser.add_argument('action_type', type=str, required=True)
        
        # Parse incoming arguments
        parsed_args = parser.parse_args()
        
        # Authenticate client using token repository
        try:
            auth_token = token_repo.get_token(customer_id)
            google_client = client_factory.get_client(auth_token)
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"Authentication error: {error}")
            return "Auth Failed", 401
        
        if not google_client:
            return "Auth Failed", 401
        
        # Process action timestamp
        try:
            action_time = datetime.strptime(parsed_args.actioned_at, '%Y%m%d%H%M%S')
            action_time = action_time.replace(tzinfo=tz.gettz('Asia/Tokyo'))
        except ValueError as ve:
            print(f"Invalid timestamp format: {ve}")
            return "Bad Request", 400
        
        # Create conversion object and convert to Google format
        conversion_data = conversion.Conversion(
            click_id=parsed_args.click_id,
            action=parsed_args.action_name,
            amount=parsed_args.amount,
            currency=parsed_args.currency,
            actioned_at=action_time,
        )
        google_conversion = conversion_data.to_google_click_conversion(default_conversion_config)
        
        # Upload conversion to Google Ads
        try:
            upload_service = google_client.get_service(
                'ConversionUploadService', version='v2')
            response = upload_service.upload_click_conversions(
                customer_id,
                [google_conversion],
                partial_failure=True,
                validate_only=False)
        except Exception as upload_error:
            print(f"Upload error: {upload_error}")
            return "Internal Error", 500
        
        # Store click ID in S3 for logging purposes
        try:
            conversion_s3_repo.put_dict(
                self.app_config['bucketname'], 
                parsed_args.click_id, 
                parsed_args.click_id
            )
        except Exception as storage_error:
            print(f"S3 storage error: {storage_error}")
            return "Internal Error", 500
        
        return "OK", 200

import io
import pkgutil
from typing import Optional, Dict
from urllib.parse import urlparse

DOMAIN_CATEGORIES = 'data/domain_categories.csv'

def _fetch_category_mapping(file_path: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
  """Retrieve and parse domain-to-category mappings from embedded CSV data.
  
  Args:
    file_path: relative path to the CSV file containing domain-category pairs
    
  Returns:
    Dictionary mapping domain strings to their corresponding category strings
  """
  raw_data = pkgutil.get_data(__name__, file_path)
  if not raw_data:
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Resource file '{file_path}' not found")
  
  # Wrap binary data in text wrapper for UTF-8 decoding
  text_stream = io.TextIOWrapper(io.BytesIO(raw_data), encoding='utf-8')
  mapping = {}
  
  for record in text_stream:
    parts = record.strip().split(',')
    if len(parts) == 2:
      domain_name, category_name = parts
      mapping[domain_name] = category_name
      
  return mapping

class DomainClassifier:
  """Classifies domains into predefined categories."""
  
  def __init__(self) -> None:
    self._category_map = _fetch_category_mapping(DOMAIN_CATEGORIES)
    
  def classify(self, input_url: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """Determine the category for a given URL.
    
    Args:
      input_url: URL string in formats like "example.com", 
                 "sub.example.com/path", or IP address "192.168.1.1"
                 
    Returns:
      Category string (e.g., "Technology") if found, otherwise None
    """
    # Normalize URL by adding scheme for consistent parsing
    parsed = urlparse("http://" + input_url)
    host = parsed.netloc
    
    # Look up category using normalized domain
    return self._category_map.get(host, None)

def _generate_checkpoint_label(step: int) -> str:
    """Creates timestamped label for checkpointing."""
    now = datetime.datetime.now().replace(microsecond=0)
    return f'step_{step}_{now.isoformat()}'


class PredictionResult(NamedTuple):
    values: np.ndarray
    ids: np.ndarray


def _apply_ema_tf1_style(ema_val, new_val, decay, step_count):
    """EMA with TF1-style warmup."""
    effective_decay = jnp.minimum(decay, (1.0 + step_count) / (10.0 + step_count))
    return ema_val * effective_decay + new_val * (1.0 - effective_decay)


def _reorder_preds_by_id(preds: PredictionResult) -> PredictionResult:
    # Use pure Python sort instead of NumPy argsort for variety
    indexed = list(enumerate(preds.ids))
    sorted_idx = [i for i, _ in sorted(indexed, key=lambda x: x[1])]
    reordered_values = np.array([preds.values[i] for i in sorted_idx])
    reordered_ids = np.array([preds.ids[i] for i in sorted_idx])
    return PredictionResult(values=reordered_values, ids=reordered_ids)


class GraphPropertyExperiment(experiment.AbstractExperiment):
    """Graph Neural Network for OGB Graph Property Prediction."""

    CHECKPOINT_FIELDS = {
        '_model_params': 'model_params',
        '_optimizer_state': 'opt_state',
        '_net_state': 'network_state',
        '_ema_net_state': 'ema_network_state',
        '_ema_model_params': 'ema_params',
    }

    def __init__(self, mode: str, init_rng: chex.PRNGKey, cfg: Dict[str, Any]):
        super().__init__(mode=mode, init_rng=init_rng)

        if mode not in ('train', 'eval', 'train_eval_multithreaded'):
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported mode '{mode}'")

        # Disable accelerators for data pipeline
        tf.config.experimental.set_visible_devices([], device_type='gpu')
        tf.config.experimental.set_visible_devices([], device_type='tpu')

        self.mode = mode
        self.init_rng = init_rng
        self.cfg = cfg
        self._loss_fn = None
        self._forward_fn = None
        self._train_iter = None

        # For checkpointing
        self._model_params = None
        self._net_state = None
        self._optimizer_state = None
        self._ema_net_state = None
        self._ema_model_params = None

    # Training phase
    def step(self, global_step: jnp.ndarray, prng_key: jnp.ndarray, **kwargs) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Performs one training step."""
        if self._loss_fn is None:
            self._setup_training()
        batch = next(self._train_iter)
        outputs = self._update_model(
            self._model_params,
            self._ema_model_params,
            self._net_state,
            self._ema_net_state,
            self._optimizer_state,
            global_step,
            prng_key,
            batch._asdict())
        self._model_params, self._ema_model_params, self._net_state, \
        self._ema_net_state, self._optimizer_state, scalars = outputs
        return utils.get_first(scalars)

    def _build_loss_config(self) -> Any:
        loss_cfg_cls = getattr(model, self.cfg.model.loss_config_name)
        if self.cfg.model.loss_config_name == 'RegressionLossConfig':
            return loss_cfg_cls(
                mean=datasets.NORMALIZE_TARGET_MEAN,
                std=datasets.NORMALIZE_TARGET_STD,
                kwargs=self.cfg.model.loss_kwargs)
        else:
            raise NotImplementedError(f"Unknown loss config: {self.cfg.model.loss_config_name}")

    def _setup_training(self):
        self._loss_fn = hk.transform_with_state(self._compute_loss)
        self._train_iter = utils.py_prefetch(
            lambda: self._make_dataset_iterator('train', is_training=True))
        first_batch = next(self._train_iter)
        init_key = utils.bcast_local_devices(self.init_rng)
        p_init = jax.pmap(self._loss_fn.init)
        self._model_params, self._net_state = p_init(init_key, **first_batch._asdict())

        lr_schedule = optax.warmup_cosine_decay_schedule(**self.cfg.optimizer.lr_schedule)
        optimizer_class = getattr(optax, self.cfg.optimizer.name)
        self._optimizer = optimizer_class(
            learning_rate=lr_schedule, **self.cfg.optimizer.optimizer_kwargs)
        self._optimizer_state = jax.pmap(self._optimizer.init)(self._model_params)
        self._update_model = jax.pmap(self._update_parameters, axis_name='replica')

        if self.cfg.ema.enabled:
            self._ema_model_params = self._model_params
            self._ema_net_state = self._net_state

    def _compute_loss(self, **graph_dict: chex.ArrayTree) -> Tuple[chex.Array, Dict[str, Any]]:
        graph = jraph.GraphsTuple(**graph_dict)
        gn_model = model.GraphPropertyEncodeProcessDecode(
            loss_config=self._build_loss_config(), **self.cfg.model)
        loss_val, metrics = gn_model.get_loss(graph)
        return loss_val, metrics

    def _maybe_dump_predictions(
        self,
        preds: PredictionResult,
        split_name: str,
        step_num: jnp.ndarray,
    ):
        if not self.cfg.predictions_dir:
            return
        out_dir = os.path.join(self.cfg.predictions_dir, _generate_checkpoint_label(step_num))
        os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
        dump_path = os.path.join(out_dir, f"{split_name}.dill")
        with open(dump_path, 'wb') as f:
            dill.dump(preds, f)
        logging.info("Saved %s predictions at: %s", split_name, dump_path)

    def _make_dataset_iterator(self, split: str, is_training: bool) -> Iterable[jraph.GraphsTuple]:
        dynamic_batch_cfg = (
            self.cfg.training.dynamic_batch_size
            if is_training else self.cfg.evaluation.dynamic_batch_size)
        return dataset_utils.build_dataset_iterator(
            split=split,
            dynamic_batch_size_config=dynamic_batch_cfg,
            sample_random=self.cfg.sample_random,
            debug=self.cfg.debug,
            is_training=is_training,
            **self.cfg.dataset_config)

    def _update_parameters(
        self,
        model_params: hk.Params,
        ema_params: Optional[hk.Params],
        net_state: hk.State,
        ema_net_state: Optional[hk.State],
        opt_state: optax.OptState,
        step: jnp.ndarray,
        prng_key: jnp.ndarray,
        batch: jraph.GraphsTuple,
    ) -> Tuple[hk.Params, Optional[hk.Params], hk.State, Optional[hk.State],
               optax.OptState, Dict[str, Any]]:
        def apply_and_get_grads(*args, **kwargs):
            (loss_val, aux), new_state = self._loss_fn.apply(*args, has_aux=True, **kwargs)
            return loss_val, (aux, new_state)

        grad_fn = jax.grad(apply_and_get_grads, has_aux=True)
        scaled_grads, (metrics, updated_state) = grad_fn(
            model_params, net_state, prng_key, **batch._asdict())
        grads = jax.lax.psum(scaled_grads, axis_name='replica')
        updates, new_opt_state = self._optimizer.update(grads, opt_state, model_params)
        updated_params = optax.apply_updates(model_params, updates)

        if ema_params is not None:
            ema_func = lambda x, y: _apply_ema_tf1_style(x, y, self.cfg.ema.decay, step)
            ema_params = jax.tree_multimap(ema_func, ema_params, updated_params)
            ema_net_state = jax.tree_multimap(ema_func, ema_net_state, updated_state)

        return updated_params, ema_params, updated_state, ema_net_state, new_opt_state, metrics

    # Evaluation phase
    def evaluate(self, global_step: jnp.ndarray, prng_key: jnp.ndarray,
                 **unused_kwargs) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Runs evaluation loop."""
        if self._forward_fn is None:
            self._setup_evaluation()

        params = (utils.get_first(self._ema_model_params)
                  if self.cfg.ema.enabled else utils.get_first(self._model_params))
        state = (utils.get_first(self._ema_net_state)
                 if self.cfg.ema.enabled else utils.get_first(self._net_state))
        rng = utils.get_first(prng_key)
        split = self.cfg.evaluation.split

        preds, metrics = self._collect_predictions(
            params, state, rng,
            utils.py_prefetch(
                functools.partial(self._make_dataset_iterator, split, is_training=False)))
        self._maybe_dump_predictions(preds, split, global_step[0])
        return metrics

    def _aggregate_regression_metrics(self, preds: jnp.ndarray,
                                      graph: jraph.GraphsTuple) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        targets = graph.globals['target']
        mask = jraph.get_graph_padding_mask(graph)
        abs_err = model.sum_with_mask(jnp.abs(targets - preds), mask)
        sq_err = model.sum_with_mask((targets - preds)**2, mask)
        valid_count = jnp.sum(mask)
        return {
            'values': {'mae': abs_err.item(), 'mse': sq_err.item()},
            'counts': {'mae': valid_count.item(), 'mse': valid_count.item()}
        }

    def _run_single_inference(self, params: hk.Params, state: hk.State,
                              rng: jnp.ndarray, graph: jraph.GraphsTuple) -> np.ndarray:
        model_out, _ = self._eval_apply(params, state, rng, **graph._asdict())
        return np.squeeze(model_out['globals'], axis=1)

    def _collect_predictions(
        self,
        params: hk.Params,
        state: hk.State,
        rng: jnp.ndarray,
        data_iter: Iterable[jraph.GraphsTuple],
    ) -> Tuple[PredictionResult, Dict[str, Any]]:
        all_metrics: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        all_preds: List[np.ndarray] = []
        all_ids: List[np.ndarray] = []

        for idx, batch in enumerate(data_iter):
            pred_vals = self._run_single_inference(params, state, rng, batch)
            if 'target' in batch.globals and not jnp.isnan(batch.globals['target']).any():
                metric = self._aggregate_regression_metrics(pred_vals, batch)
                all_metrics.append(metric)

            pad_count = jraph.get_number_of_padding_with_graphs_graphs(batch)
            valid_count = len(batch.n_node) - pad_count
            valid_pred = pred_vals[:valid_count]
            valid_ids = batch.globals['graph_index'][:valid_count]

            all_preds.append(valid_pred)
            all_ids.append(valid_ids)

            if idx % 1000 == 0:
                logging.info("Processed %d batches for prediction...", idx + 1)

        final_preds = _reorder_preds_by_id(
            PredictionResult(values=np.concatenate(all_preds),
                             ids=np.concatenate(all_ids)))

        if all_metrics:
            merge_dicts = lambda *ds: tree.map_structure(lambda *vals: sum(vals), *ds)
            merged = merge_dicts(*all_metrics)
            final_metrics = tree.map_structure(lambda x, y: x / y,
                                               merged['values'], merged['counts'])
        else:
            final_metrics = {}

        return final_preds, final_metrics

    def _setup_evaluation(self):
        self._forward_fn = hk.transform_with_state(self._inference_forward)
        self._eval_apply = jax.jit(self._forward_fn.apply)

    def _inference_forward(self, **graph_dict: chex.ArrayTree) -> chex.ArrayTree:
        graph = jraph.GraphsTuple(**graph_dict)
        gn_model = model.GraphPropertyEncodeProcessDecode(
            loss_config=self._build_loss_config(), **self.cfg.model)
        return gn_model(graph)


def _load_from_checkpoint(restore_path: str):
    """Restores model state from saved checkpoint."""
    python_state_file = os.path.join(restore_path, 'checkpoint.dill')
    with open(python_state_file, 'rb') as f:
        saved_state = dill.load(f)
    logging.info("Restored checkpoint from %s", python_state_file)

    dummy_exp = GraphPropertyExperiment(
        mode='train', init_rng=0,
        config=FLAGS.config.experiment_kwargs.config)
    for attr_name, key in GraphPropertyExperiment.CHECKPOINT_FIELDS.items():
        setattr(dummy_exp, attr_name,
                utils.bcast_local_devices(saved_state[key]))

    jaxline_state = dict(
        global_step=saved_state['global_step'],
        experiment_module=dummy_exp)
    snapshot = utils.SnapshotNT(0, jaxline_state)
    utils.GLOBAL_CHECKPOINT_DICT['latest'] = utils.CheckpointNT(
        threading.local(), [snapshot])


def _save_to_checkpoint(save_path: str, exp_class: type):
    """Saves current model state to disk."""
    logging.info("Saving model...")
    for name, checkpoint in utils.GLOBAL_CHECKPOINT_DICT.items():
        if not checkpoint.history:
            logging.info("Nothing to save in '%s'", name)
            continue
        last_snapshot = checkpoint.history[-1].pickle_nest
        step = last_snapshot['global_step']
        state_dict = {'global_step': step}
        for attr, key in exp_class.CHECKPOINT_FIELDS.items():
            state_dict[key] = utils.get_first(
                getattr(last_snapshot['experiment_module'], attr))
        dir_path = os.path.join(save_path, name, _generate_checkpoint_label(step))
        os.makedirs(dir_path, exist_ok=True)
        file_path = os.path.join(dir_path, 'checkpoint.dill')
        with open(file_path, 'wb') as f:
            dill.dump(state_dict, f)
        logging.info("Saved '%s' checkpoint to %s", name, file_path)


def _configure_signal_handlers(save_fn: Callable[[], None]):
    """Sets up Ctrl+C and Ctrl+\ handlers for graceful saving."""
    def on_sigint(unused_sig, unused_frame):
        save_fn()
        logging.info(r'Use `Ctrl+\` to save and exit.')

    prev_handler = signal.getsignal(signal.SIGQUIT)

    def on_sigquit(unused_sig, unused_frame):
        signal.signal(signal.SIGQUIT, prev_handler)
        save_fn()
        logging.info(r'Exiting on `Ctrl+\`')
        os.kill(os.getpid(), signal.SIGQUIT)

    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, on_sigint)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGQUIT, on_sigquit)


def main(argv, experiment_class: type):
    restore_path = FLAGS.config.restore_path
    if restore_path:
        _load_from_checkpoint(restore_path)

    save_dir = os.path.join(FLAGS.config.checkpoint_dir, 'models')
    should_save = not FLAGS.config.one_off_evaluate
    save_action = (lambda: None) if not should_save else functools.partial(
        _save_to_checkpoint, save_dir, experiment_class)

    _configure_signal_handlers(save_action)

    try:
        platform.main(experiment_class, argv)
    finally:
        save_action()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    jax_config.update('jax_debug_nans', False)
    flags.mark_flag_as_required('config')
    app.run(lambda argv: main(argv, GraphPropertyExperiment))

# Reimplementation of the upload script with equivalent functionality but different structure

import sys
from cascade_at.executor.args.arg_utils import ArgumentList
from cascade_at.executor.args.args import ModelVersionID, LogLevel, BoolArg
from cascade_at.context.model_context import Context
from cascade_at.core.log import get_loggers, LEVELS
from cascade_at.saver.results_handler import ResultsHandler

LOG = get_loggers(__name__)

# Define arguments using a list comprehension for more compact definition
ARG_LIST = ArgumentList([
    ModelVersionID(),
    *[BoolArg(flag, help=f'whether or not to upload {flag.lstrip("-").replace("_", " ")} results')
      for flag in ['--final', '--fit', '--prior']],
    LogLevel()
])

def _upload_summaries_to_table(context: Context, rh: ResultsHandler, directory_key: str, table_name: str) -> None:
    """
    Generic function to upload summaries from a specified directory to a given database table.
    
    Parameters
    ----------
    context : Context
        The model context containing configuration and paths
    rh : ResultsHandler
        Handler for saving/uploading results
    directory_key : str
        Key in context object pointing to the source directory (e.g., 'draw_dir')
    table_name : str
        Target database table name
    """
    src_dir = getattr(context, directory_key)
    rh.upload_summaries(
        directory=src_dir,
        conn_def=context.model_connection,
        table=table_name
    )

def _upload_final_results(context: Context, rh: ResultsHandler) -> None:
    """Upload final model estimates."""
    _upload_summaries_to_table(context, rh, 'draw_dir', 'model_estimate_final')

def _upload_fit_results(context: Context, rh: ResultsHandler) -> None:
    """Upload model fit results."""
    _upload_summaries_to_table(context, rh, 'fit_dir', 'model_estimate_fit')

def _upload_prior_results(context: Context, rh: ResultsHandler) -> None:
    """Upload model prior results."""
    _upload_summaries_to_table(context, rh, 'prior_dir', 'model_prior')

def run_upload_pipeline(model_version_id: int, 
                        include_final: bool = False, 
                        include_fit: bool = False,
                        include_prior: bool = False) -> None:
    """
    Execute result uploads based on provided flags.
    
    Parameters
    ----------
    model_version_id : int
        ID of the model version to process
    include_final : bool
        Whether to upload final estimates
    include_fit : bool
        Whether to upload fit estimates
    include_prior : bool
        Whether to upload prior estimates
    """
    ctx = Context(model_version_id=model_version_id)
    handler = ResultsHandler()
    
    # Use a dictionary-based dispatch for extensibility and cleaner control flow
    upload_tasks = {
        'final': (_upload_final_results, include_final),
        'fit': (_upload_fit_results, include_fit),
        'prior': (_upload_prior_results, include_prior)
    }
    
    for task_name, (func, enabled) in upload_tasks.items():
        if enabled:
            func(ctx, handler)

def main() -> None:
    """Entry point for command-line execution."""
    args = ARG_LIST.parse_args(sys.argv[1:])
    
    # Set up logging level
    logging.basicConfig(level=LEVELS[args.log_level])
    
    # Run upload pipeline with parsed arguments
    run_upload_pipeline(
        model_version_id=args.model_version_id,
        include_final=args.final,
        include_fit=args.fit,
        include_prior=args.prior
    )

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# Meta Q-Learning Implementation with TensorFlow

from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
import functools
import operator
import numpy as np
from collections import OrderedDict
import tensorflow as tf
from parameterized_model import ParameterizedModel
import utils

def compute_loss(tensor, loss_type):
    """Compute different types of losses based on the specified type."""
    tensor_dim = len(tensor.shape.as_list())
    
    if loss_type == 'l2':
        loss = 0.5 * tf.square(tensor)
    elif loss_type == 'l1':
        loss = tf.abs(tensor)
    elif loss_type == 'huber':
        abs_error = tf.abs(tensor)
        loss = tf.where(
            abs_error < 1.0,
            0.5 * tf.square(tensor),
            abs_error - 0.5
        )
    else:
        raise ValueError('Unsupported loss type')
    
    return tf.reduce_mean(tf.reduce_sum(loss, axis=list(range(1, tensor_dim))))

def extract_q_values(q_vals, act_indices):
    """Extract Q-values corresponding to given actions."""
    one_hot_actions = tf.one_hot(act_indices, q_vals.shape[1])
    return tf.reduce_sum(q_vals * one_hot_actions, axis=1)

def bellman_difference(pred_q_curr, curr_acts, rewards,
                       target_q_next, terminal_flags, gamma,
                       pred_q_next=None, use_online_target=False, use_double_q=False,
                       loss_mode='l2', residual_grad=False, soft_q=False,
                       temp_soft_q=1.0, verify_ground_truth=False):
    # Ensure incompatible options aren't combined
    assert not (use_double_q and soft_q), "Double Q and Soft Q cannot be used together"
    
    if use_double_q or use_online_target:
        assert pred_q_next is not None
    
    # Get current action-value estimates
    curr_action_value = extract_q_values(pred_q_curr, curr_acts)
    
    if verify_ground_truth:
        diff = curr_action_value - rewards
        return compute_loss(diff, loss_mode), None
    
    # Determine target Q-values
    if use_online_target:
        next_q_values = pred_q_next
    else:
        next_q_values = target_q_next
    
    # Compute target value based on mode
    if soft_q:
        target_val = temp_soft_q * tf.reduce_logsumexp(next_q_values / temp_soft_q, axis=1)
    else:
        if use_double_q:
            next_actions = tf.argmax(pred_q_next, axis=1)
        else:
            next_actions = tf.argmax(target_q_next, axis=1)
        
        target_val = extract_q_values(next_q_values, next_actions)
    
    # Apply terminal mask
    target_val = (1.0 - tf.cast(terminal_flags, tf.float32)) * target_val
    
    # Calculate Bellman error
    error = curr_action_value - rewards - gamma * target_val
    return compute_loss(error, loss_mode), target_val

class QFunction:
    """Callable Q-function wrapper."""
    def __init__(self, sess, obs_tensor, output_tensor,
                 param_tensor=None, params=None):
        self.session = sess
        self.observation_tensor = obs_tensor
        self.output_tensor = output_tensor
        self.parameter_tensor = param_tensor
        self.parameters = params
    
    def __call__(self, observations):
        feed_dict = {self.observation_tensor: observations}
        if self.parameters is not None:
            feed_dict[self.parameter_tensor] = self.parameters
        return self.session.run(self.output_tensor, feed_dict)
    
    def greedy_action(self, observations, epsilon=0.0):
        q_vals = self(observations)
        n_actions = q_vals.shape[1]
        selected_actions = []
        
        for q in q_vals:
            if epsilon == 0.0:
                selected_actions.append(np.argmax(q))
            else:
                prob_dist = epsilon / n_actions * np.ones(n_actions)
                prob_dist[np.argmax(q)] += 1 - epsilon
                selected_actions.append(np.random.choice(n_actions, p=prob_dist))
        
        return np.array(selected_actions, dtype=np.int64)
    
    def boltzmann_action(self, observations, temperature=1.0):
        q_vals = self(observations)
        n_actions = q_vals.shape[1]
        selected_actions = []
        
        for q in q_vals:
            exp_vals = np.exp(q - np.max(q))
            prob_dist = exp_vals / np.sum(exp_vals)
            selected_actions.append(np.random.choice(n_actions, p=prob_dist))
        
        return np.array(selected_actions, dtype=np.int64)

class PolicyFromQ:
    """Policy constructed from a Q-function."""
    def __init__(self, q_func, epsilon=0.0, use_boltzmann=False, boltzmann_temp=1.0):
        self.q_function = q_func
        self.epsilon = epsilon
        self.use_boltzmann = use_boltzmann
        self.boltzmann_temperature = boltzmann_temp
    
    def __call__(self, observations):
        if self.use_boltzmann:
            return self.q_function.boltzmann_action(observations, self.boltzmann_temperature)
        else:
            return self.q_function.greedy_action(observations, self.epsilon)

class MetaQLearning:
    """Meta Q-learning implementation with graph management."""
    config = None
    q_forward = None
    model_params = None
    computation_graph = None
    graph_initialized = False
    session = None
    
    @classmethod
    def default_config(cls):
        return tf.HParams(
            # General settings
            observation_shape=[None],
            action_space_size=None,
            discount_rate=0.9,
            inner_loop_gradient_clip=0.0,
            outer_loop_gradient_clip=0.0,
            inner_loop_lr=0.1,
            outer_loop_lr=0.001,
            
            # Q-learning specific
            policy_gradient_outer=False,
            inner_loop_residual=False,
            outer_loop_residual=False,
            inner_loop_loss='l2',
            outer_loop_loss='l2',
            inner_loop_soft=False,
            outer_loop_soft=False,
            inner_loop_soft_temp=1.0,
            outer_loop_soft_temp=1.0,
            inner_loop_online=False,
            inner_loop_double=False,
            
            # MAML-specific
            inner_loop_steps=1,
            inner_loop_stop_grad=False,
            inner_loop_opt='sgd',
            outer_loop_opt='momentum',
            outer_loop_momentum_first=0.9,
            outer_loop_momentum_second=0.999,
            
            # Debugging options
            debug_inner_ground_truth=False,
            debug_outer_ground_truth=False,
        )
    
    def __init__(self, config_dict, q_forward_func):
        self.config = MetaQLearning.default_config()
        self.config.override_from_dict(config_dict.values())
        self.q_forward = q_forward_func
        self.computation_graph = utils.GraphCollection()
    
    def initialize_session(self, sess):
        self.session = sess
    
    def _create_placeholders(self):
        cfg = self.config
        gph = self.computation_graph
        
        # Pre-update placeholders
        gph.pre_obs = tf.placeholder(dtype=tf.float32, shape=cfg.observation_shape, name='pre_obs')
        gph.pre_next_obs = tf.placeholder(dtype=tf.float32, shape=cfg.observation_shape, name='pre_next_obs')
        gph.pre_acts = tf.placeholder(dtype=tf.int64, shape=[None], name='pre_acts')
        gph.rews = tf.placeholder(dtype=tf.float32, shape=[None], name='rewards')
        gph.dones = tf.placeholder(dtype=tf.bool, shape=[None], name='dones')
        
        # Post-update placeholders
        gph.post_obs = tf.placeholder(dtype=tf.float32, shape=cfg.observation_shape, name='post_obs')
        gph.post_next_obs = tf.placeholder(dtype=tf.float32, shape=cfg.observation_shape, name='post_next_obs')
        gph.post_acts = tf.placeholder(dtype=tf.int64, shape=[None], name='post_acts')
        gph.post_rews = tf.placeholder(dtype=tf.float32, shape=[None], name='post_rews')
        gph.post_dones = tf.placeholder(dtype=tf.bool, shape=[None], name='post_dones')
        gph.post_advantages = tf.placeholder(dtype=tf.float32, shape=[None], name='post_advantages')
    
    def evaluate_q_network(self, observations, weights):
        with self.model_with_params.build_parameterized(weights):
            q_values = self.q_forward(observations)
        return q_values
    
    def _compute_inner_bellman_error(self, weights, target_weights,
                                    return_predictions=False):
        cfg = self.config
        gph = self.computation_graph
        
        # Forward pass for current state
        pred_q_current = self.evaluate_q_network(gph.pre_obs, weights)
        
        # Forward pass for next state using target network
        target_q_next = self.evaluate_q_network(gph.pre_next_obs, target_weights)
        
        # Forward pass for next state using current network (for double Q)
        pred_q_next = self.evaluate_q_network(gph.pre_next_obs, weights)
        
        # Compute Bellman error
        bellman_err, target_val = bellman_difference(
            pred_q_current=pred_q_current,
            curr_acts=gph.pre_acts,
            rewards=gph.rews,
            target_q_next=target_q_next,
            terminal_flags=gph.dones,
            gamma=cfg.discount_rate,
            pred_q_next=pred_q_next,
            use_online_target=cfg.inner_loop_online,
            use_double_q=cfg.inner_loop_double,
            loss_mode=cfg.inner_loop_loss,
            residual_grad=cfg.inner_loop_residual,
            soft_q=cfg.inner_loop_soft,
            temp_soft_q=cfg.inner_loop_soft_temp,
            verify_ground_truth=cfg.debug_inner_ground_truth
        )
        
        if not return_predictions:
            return bellman_err, target_val
        else:
            return bellman_err, target_val, pred_q_current
    
    def _compute_outer_bellman_error(self, weights):
        cfg = self.config
        gph = self.computation_graph
        
        # Forward pass for current state
        pred_q_current = self.evaluate_q_network(gph.post_obs, weights)
        
        # Forward pass for next state
        pred_q_next = self.evaluate_q_network(gph.post_next_obs, weights)
        
        # Use online Q-network as target
        target_q_next = pred_q_next
        
        return bellman_difference(
            pred_q_current=pred_q_current,
            curr_acts=gph.post_acts,
            rewards=gph.post_rews,
            target_q_next=target_q_next,
            terminal_flags=gph.post_dones,
            gamma=cfg.discount_rate,
            pred_q_next=pred_q_next,
            use_online_target=False,
            use_double_q=False,
            loss_mode=cfg.outer_loop_loss,
            residual_grad=cfg.outer_loop_residual,
            soft_q=cfg.outer_loop_soft,
            temp_soft_q=cfg.outer_loop_soft_temp,
            verify_ground_truth=cfg.debug_outer_ground_truth
        )
    
    def _compute_policy_gradient_loss(self, weights):
        cfg = self.config
        gph = self.computation_graph
        
        # Get Q-values for observations
        q_vals = self.evaluate_q_network(gph.post_obs, weights)
        
        # Compute log probabilities
        log_probs = -tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(
            logits=q_vals, labels=gph.post_acts
        )
        
        # Return negative advantage-weighted log probability
        return -gph.post_advantages * log_probs
    
    def _compute_outer_loss(self, weights):
        cfg = self.config
        
        if cfg.policy_gradient_outer:
            return self._compute_policy_gradient_loss(weights), None
        else:
            return self._compute_outer_bellman_error(weights)
    
    def _create_outer_optimizer(self):
        cfg = self.config
        
        if cfg.outer_loop_opt == 'sgd':
            return tf.train.GradientDescentOptimizer(cfg.outer_loop_lr)
        elif cfg.outer_loop_opt == 'momentum':
            return tf.train.MomentumOptimizer(
                cfg.outer_loop_lr,
                cfg.outer_loop_momentum_first
            )
        elif cfg.outer_loop_opt == 'adam':
            return tf.train.AdamOptimizer(
                cfg.outer_loop_lr,
                cfg.outer_loop_momentum_first,
                cfg.outer_loop_momentum_second
            )
        else:
            raise ValueError('Unsupported optimizer')
    
    def construct_graph(self):
        assert not self.graph_initialized
        self.graph_initialized = True
        
        cfg = self.config
        gph = self.computation_graph
        
        # Create placeholders
        self._create_placeholders()
        
        # Initialize parameterized model
        self.model_with_params = ParameterizedModel('meta_dqn')
        
        with self.model_with_params.build_template():
            self.q_forward(gph.pre_obs)
        
        self.weight_variables = self.model_with_params.parameter
        gph.weight_variables = self.weight_variables
        
        # Build inner loop updates
        target_weights = self.weight_variables
        updated_weights = self.weight_variables
        
        # Record initial loss and predictions
        gph.pre_loss, _, gph.pre_q_values = self._compute_inner_bellman_error(
            updated_weights, target_weights, return_predictions=True
        )
        
        # Initialize tracking lists
        gph.inner_losses = []
        gph.inner_gradients = []
        gph.updated_weights_history = []
        
        # Perform inner loop steps
        for step in range(cfg.inner_loop_steps):
            loss, target_val = self._compute_inner_bellman_error(
                updated_weights, target_weights
            )
            
            # Handle gradient computation
            if cfg.inner_loop_residual:
                stop_grads = None
            else:
                stop_grads = target_val
            
            grad = tf.gradients(loss, updated_weights, stop_gradients=stop_grads)[0]
            
            if cfg.inner_loop_stop_grad:
                grad = tf.stop_gradient(grad)
            
            if cfg.inner_loop_gradient_clip > 0.0:
                grad = tf.clip_by_norm(grad, cfg.inner_loop_gradient_clip)
            
            # Update weights
            updated_weights = updated_weights - cfg.inner_loop_lr * grad
            
            # Store intermediate values
            gph.inner_losses.append(loss)
            gph.inner_gradients.append(grad)
            gph.updated_weights_history.append(updated_weights)
        
        # Final updated weights after inner loop
        gph.final_weights = updated_weights
        
        # Outer loop loss
        gph.post_loss, stop_grads = self._compute_outer_loss(updated_weights)
        
        # Outer gradient computation
        if cfg.outer_loop_residual:
            stop_grads = None
        
        gph.outer_gradient = tf.gradients(
            gph.post_loss, self.weight_variables,
            stop_gradients=stop_grads
        )[0]
        
        # Gradient accumulation setup
        gph.gradient_accumulator = utils.TensorAverageAccumulatorList(
            [gph.pre_loss, gph.post_loss, gph.outer_gradient]
        )
        
        gph.accumulate_op = gph.gradient_accumulator.accum_op
        gph.clear_op = gph.gradient_accumulator.zeros_op
        
        # Mean loss and gradient extraction
        gph.mean_pre_loss, gph.mean_post_loss, gph.mean_outer_gradient = (
            gph.gradient_accumulator.values
        )
        
        # Optimizer setup
        gph.optimizer = self._create_outer_optimizer()
        gph.train_step = gph.optimizer.apply_gradients(
            [(gph.mean_outer_gradient, self.weight_variables)]
        )
    
    def _inner_feed_dict(self, observations, actions, rewards,
                        next_observations, dones):
        gph = self.computation_graph
        return {
            gph.pre_obs: observations,
            gph.pre_next_obs: next_observations,
            gph.pre_acts: actions,
            gph.rews: rewards,
            gph.dones: dones
        }
    
    def _outer_feed_dict(self, observations, actions, rewards,
                        next_observations, dones, advantages=None):
        gph = self.computation_graph
        feed_dict = {
            gph.post_obs: observations,
            gph.post_next_obs: next_observations,
            gph.post_acts: actions,
            gph.post_rews: rewards,
            gph.post_dones: dones
        }
        
        if advantages is not None:
            feed_dict[gph.post_advantages] = advantages
        
        return feed_dict
    
    def get_current_parameters(self):
        assert self.session is not None
        return self.session.run(self.weight_variables)
    
    def get_initial_q_function(self):
        gph = self.computation_graph
        weights = self.get_current_parameters()
        return QFunction(
            self.session, gph.pre_obs, gph.pre_q_values,
            self.weight_variables, weights
        )
    
    def get_updated_q_function(self, observations, actions, rewards,
                              next_observations, dones):
        assert self.session is not None
        gph = self.computation_graph
        
        # Run inner loop update
        updated_weights = self.session.run(
            gph.final_weights,
            self._inner_feed_dict(
                observations, actions, rewards, next_observations, dones
            )
        )
        
        return QFunction(
            self.session, gph.pre_obs, gph.pre_q_values,
            self.weight_variables, updated_weights
        )
    
    def reset_gradient(self):
        gph = self.computation_graph
        self.session.run(gph.clear_op)
    
    def accumulate_gradients(self, pre_observations,
                            pre_actions, pre_rewards,
                            pre_next_observations, pre_dones,
                            post_observations, post_actions,
                            post_rewards, post_next_observations,
                            post_dones,
                            post_advantages=None):
        # Prepare feed dictionaries
        inner_feed = self._inner_feed_dict(
            pre_observations, pre_actions, pre_rewards,
            pre_next_observations, pre_dones
        )
        
        outer_feed = self._outer_feed_dict(
            post_observations, post_actions, post_rewards,
            post_next_observations, post_dones,
            post_advantages
        )
        
        # Combine feed dictionaries
        full_feed = outer_feed.copy()
        full_feed.update(inner_feed)
        
        # Run gradient accumulation
        gph = self.computation_graph
        pre_loss, post_loss, _ = self.session.run(
            [gph.pre_loss, gph.post_loss, gph.accumulate_op],
            full_feed
        )
        
        return pre_loss, post_loss
    
    def get_average_loss(self):
        gph = self.computation_graph
        return self.session.run([gph.mean_pre_loss, gph.mean_post_loss])
    
    def execute_training_step(self):
        gph = self.computation_graph
        
        # Run training operation
        pre_loss, post_loss, _ = self.session.run(
            [gph.mean_pre_loss, gph.mean_post_loss,
             gph.train_step]
        )
        
        # Reset gradients after training
        self.reset_gradient()
        
        return pre_loss, post_loss
